chapter.verse: Ukna nei tungsiahte' nuai-ah mimal kim niamlut ta hen. A hang pen Pasian' kiangpan longal ukzawhna thu om theilo a, a omte pen Pasian' phuh ahi hi.
Tua hangin ukna neite a lehpan peuhmah Pasian' koihsa thu a lehpan hi a, tua banga a lehpante in thukhenna tuak ding uh hi.
A taktakin gam-uk uliante a kihta ding pen gamtat a hoihte hilo-in gamtat a siate ahi hi. Ukna nei mi khat kihta lo-in na om nuam uh hiam? A hoihin na gamtat uhleh ama' pahtak na ngah ding uh hi.

Amah pen note' hoih nading a sem Pasian' nasem ahi hi. Ahih hangin a namsau a mawk tawi hilo ahih manin na siat gamtat uhleh kihta un. Amah pen a siat gamtatte' tungah a thukkikpa hi a, Pasian' hehna gau a tungsak Pasian' nasem ahi hi.
Tua hi a, Pasian' hehna pelh nading bek hilo-in kitheihtawmna lungsim hangin ukna nuai-ah omloh phamawh hi.
Hih thu hangin note in zong phiangsiah na pia uh hi. Ukna neite pen hih thu ngiat a sem dinga om Pasian' nasemte ahi uh hi.
Mi khempeuh' tungah amau' ngah ding tek—phiangsiah a ngah dingte phiangsiah, maangmu a ngah dingte maangmu, thupibawl dingte thupibawlna, zahtak dingte zahtakna—pia un.
Khatlekhat ki-it ding cih thu longal kuamah' tungah leiba bangmah nei kei un. A hang pen midang a itte, thukhun a cin uh ahi hi.

A hang pen, “Angkawm kei in, tualthat kei in, gu kei in, deihgawh kei in,” cih thupiaknate leh a dang teng khempeuh a vekin, “Na vengte nangmahmah bangin na it ding hi,” a cihna sungah kigawmkhawm khin hi.
Itna in vengte' tungah khialhna bawl lo hi; tua hi a, itna pen thukhun buppi a cinna ahi hi.
Hih thu banah, na ihmutna uh pan khanlawh ding hun, a hunlenai tung ta cih na thei uh hi. Tu-in hotkhiatna pen i up cil lai sangin eite tawh hong naizaw ta hi.
Zan khuamial bei dektak ta a, sun khuavak hong nai ta hi. Tua ahih manin khuamial gamtatziate paaikhia-in khuavak galvan teng tawh kithawi ta ni.
Gualnop gamlumna leh zukham sakhamna, nulepa tatkhialhna leh cilesa paktatna, kitotna leh kidemnopna, cihte zang lo-in sun khuavak sunga omte bangin a kilawmin gamta ni.
Topa Jesu Khris puan bangin silh unla, na pumpi uh cilesa lunggulhna a sep theih nading hun omsak kei un.
